title: 4 Filters to Discern God’s Voice
hook: Stop guessing. Use these four Bible-based filters to discern God’s voice today.
script: Stop guessing. Use these four Bible-based filters to discern God’s voice today. First, Scripture alignment. Like the Bereans in Acts 17:11, check if it clearly agrees with God’s Word. Second, Christlike fruit and tone. Does it sound like Jesus and produce love, joy, peace, and self-control? Galatians 5:22–23. Third, peace versus pressure. Let Christ’s peace rule your heart, not panic or manipulation. Colossians 3:15. Fourth, wise counsel and time. Seek mature voices; Proverbs 11:14. Two-minute practice: write the decision, test it through the four, pray, then take the next small obedient step. If any filter flags red, pause, don’t spiral. God isn’t rushed, and He’s not trying to trick you.

title: When God Feels Silent
hook: If God feels silent right now, try this simple grid.
script: If God feels silent right now, try this simple grid. One, Scripture: does it align, not just vaguely, but clearly? Acts 17:11. Two, fruit and tone: would Jesus say it like that, and will it grow love, joy, and peace? Galatians 5:22–23. Three, peace over pressure: is there a settled yes from Christ ruling your heart? Colossians 3:15. Four, wise counsel plus time: do trusted believers nudge the same direction as you wait? Proverbs 11:14. Two-minute practice: breathe, write the decision in one sentence, walk it through the four, pray, and obey the next tiny step. Clarity builds in motion; confusion grows in rumination.

title: Stop Overthinking God’s Will
hook: You may be overthinking this. God’s not hiding, and He won’t let you miss Him.
script: You may be overthinking this. God’s not hiding, and He won’t let you miss Him. Ask four questions. Does this match Scripture? Acts 17:11. Does it sound like Jesus and lead to the Spirit’s fruit, not fear? Galatians 5:22–23. Does Christ’s peace referee my heart, or do I feel rushed and shamed? Colossians 3:15. Are wise believers confirming it as I give it a little time? Proverbs 11:14. Set a two-minute timer, journal your decision, run it through these, then choose one faithful step in the next 24 hours. Clarity often shows up after obedience, not before.
